content: CodeMirror 6 (modular, ~50KB core, tree-shakeable) is preferred over Monaco Editor (2-5MB) for an embedded raw-JSON fallback editor, especially because this project's frontend build output ships INSIDE the published npm tarball (not loaded from a CDN at runtime) - Monaco's size would bloat every npx install. Monaco is justified only when full VS Code-grade IntelliSense/LSP is a core requirement, which it is not here since guided forms are the primary UX.
